name: bug-report
description: Verify suspected upstream defects, use their documented reporting channel, and follow up for one fixed 30-minute window.

run.reason: Current-context incident investigation and reporting has no delegated workers or separate implementation strategy; evidence, publication authority and finite monitoring guards still apply.

resume.reason: Reconcile the existing incident in the current context without worker dispatch, resetting budgets or extending the original monitoring deadline.

status.reason: Read-only incident inspection has no synthesis or dispatch.

cancel.reason: Record cancellation and reconcile only the incident's owned monitoring task; no worker dispatch or unrelated cleanup.
